title: RunPod connect feedback lies: home strip reads LOCAL - OFFLINE and 0 / 24 while connecting, Cancel shows nothing while RunPod's delete hangs
description: Seen live 2026-10-10 (MPI-623 session 44, PRO 6000 Pod fx1mghpdhuzmdz stalled by RunPod with an empty System log): (1) the home strip (heroStats) read LOCAL - OFFLINE + the local GPU while Settings said 'Remote engine: connecting...' - heroStats HAS a 'connecting - offline' + % state (MPI-73/87/274), so some remote:connection emit with phase:null cleared it; no [settings] warning fired, cause unproven. (2) MODELS read 0 / 24 during the connect (local disk is full of weights). (3) Cancel sent /remote/pod/delete-active, but RunPod's DELETE hung on the stuck Pod until Fabio pressed Stop in the console (~2 min); the panel gave no sign it was still waiting. Fabio: fix right away.
